Potential G7-M-5 after a boiling-as-particle-energy example.

Tabon (megapode) diet of seeds, fruit, worms, and insects is true, but it is a diet list, not G3-L-7 explaining dependence, G4-L-6 herbivore/carnivore/omnivore grouping, or a drawn food chain. G5-L-4:insects and G5-L-6:birds would swallow into classification/life cycle. G3-L-4:fin is finds⊃fin. TL buto/prutas/uod/insekto / BIS binhi/prutas/ulod/insekto OK. G3-M-5/G4-F-6 stretch are solid/force shape, not a bird neck. TL tagak/leeg / BIS tagak/liog OK. Potential G3-L-4 after a neck-in-flight role, or G4-L-3 after aerial without a diagram.

Talahib (cogon) colonizing cleared land is a real pioneer, but G5-L-8 is drought/flood adaptation and is not admitted. G3-L-3:grow is grow-as-a-sign-of-life, not succession. G3-L-8 plant is conserve-actions; G4-L-3:land is a habitat diagram. TL/BIS talahib/tumutubo/motubo OK. Potential G5-L-8 after a pioneer/disturbed-land adaptation facet.

Fingernail, coin, or nail scratching talc is a current G3-M-5 hardness teaching component (Mohs field test of a solid; same bar as mineral-hardness-everyday-g4). Only the hardness facet matches; shine/stretch do not. G3-L-4:fin is fingernail⊃fin. Investigation/test units (G3-M-2, G3-F-6, G4-F-1:guided, G4-F-7, G6-F-3, G7-M-10, G9-M-11:focus-5) are not credited. G4-F-1:rigid is motion/shape; G5-E-4:minerals is soil formation; G9-M-11:hard is bonding-type investigation. NPS: talc is the softest mineral (https://www.nps.gov/subjects/geology/minerals.htm). TL tigas/magasgasan / BIS katig-a/makalmotan OK. Parent verification: Talc scratched by common objects is a solid-hardness observation for G3-M-5:hardness only. EN/TL/BIS agree on scratching/easy damage; no standalone investigation facet admits. Original NPS source independently checked: https://www.nps.gov/subjects/geology/minerals.htm confirms talc is scratched by a fingernail.
